total_per_student.formula: gross local + state + federal revenue / fall survey enrollment
total_per_student.source_note: local is GROSS property tax collections; TEA reports M&O revenue net of recapture, which understates property-funded districts

local_per_student.formula: gross local M&O tax + I&S tax + other local revenue / fall survey enrollment
local_per_student.source_note: local is GROSS property tax collections; TEA reports M&O revenue net of recapture, which understates property-funded districts

state_per_student.source_note: local is GROSS property tax collections; TEA reports M&O revenue net of recapture, which understates property-funded districts

federal_per_student.source_note: local is GROSS property tax collections; TEA reports M&O revenue net of recapture, which understates property-funded districts

spend_instruction_per_student.formula: instruction spending (TEA functions 11-95) / fall survey enrollment
spend_instruction_per_student.source_note: instruction is TEA function codes 11-95, which include classroom transfers

spend_debt_per_student.formula: total debt service expenditure / fall survey enrollment
spend_debt_per_student.source_note: debt service sits OUTSIDE TEA's operating total; the card's total is operating + debt, composed, never subtracted

spend_operating_per_student.formula: total operating expenditure by function / fall survey enrollment
spend_operating_per_student.source_note: excludes debt service and capital construction by TEA's own definition of operating

lineage_statewide.filter: fall survey enrollment > 0 and total disbursements > 0

statewide_total_spend.formula: sum of all_funds_total_disbursements over districts reporting enrollment and spending

statewide_spend_per_student.denominator_type: sum of fall survey enrollment over the same districts
statewide_spend_per_student.formula: sum of all_funds_total_disbursements / sum of fall survey enrollment

lineage_recomputation.road: data/texas_finance_clean.csv + data/tea_property.csv, re-read longhand by scripts/recompute_revenue.py; data/texas_finance_clean.csv, re-read longhand by scripts/recompute_spending.py
lineage_recomputation.note: Agreement means our two roads arrive at the same place. It cannot make TEA's filing right — districts file PEIMS and it is corrected for years afterwards.

meta.dollars: constant 2024 dollars where marked real; CPI-U annual average
sources: TEA Summarized PEIMS Actual Financial Data, fiscal 2009-2025
TEA/Comptroller certified property values, tax years 2015-2025
TEA school district adopted tax rates, 2005-06 to 2023-24
TEA recapture paid by district, fiscal 1994-2026
limits: Effect sizes are observational. Within-district first differences remove everything about a district that does not change, but not confounders that move at the same time.
TEA does not itemise facilities: debt service covers all buildings together, so a stadium cannot be separated from a roof without a district's own bond documents.
Tax figures are withheld for districts where two independent estimates of the tax base disagree by more than 25%.

micro.note: effects are the change in STAAR percent-approaches for a one-unit change in the lever, within the same district over three years, with year effects and district-clustered errors

meta.note: Every claim links to its source; nothing here overwrites stored data. Extraction is rule-based unless a finding shows structured facts, which come from an LLM reading only that source snippet as untrusted data.
